_doc: Context for translators: what each key is and where it appears. {braces} are placeholders and must stay.
site.name: The site's full name; appears in the header and page titles. Keep in English or transliterate as you prefer.
hub.h1: Main heading of the home page.
hub.time: Table column: how long until an exchange credits the deposit.
wallet_vs_exchange.title: Box explaining the difference between a network fee and an exchange withdrawal fee (users confuse these).
calc.from: Calculator field: where the money is sent from (own wallet, or an exchange name).
case.existing_recipient: Tron/Ethereum: the recipient already has USDT, so the transfer is cheaper.
case.new_recipient: Tron/Ethereum: the recipient has never held USDT, so the transfer costs more.
ex.unverified: Shown when a hand-maintained fact has no verification date yet.
method.saudi_text: Regulatory note; must stay neutral and factual.
widget.credit: Credit line inside the embeddable widget; {site} becomes the site name with a link.
wallet_vs_exchange.wallet_lead: Bold lead-in of the first line in the "two fees" box; keep the colon.
wallet_vs_exchange.exchange_lead: Bold lead-in of the second line; keep the colon.
ex.network_fee: Table cell for an exchange that charges no fixed withdrawal fee but passes the live blockchain fee through (BitOasis). Short, lower case.
history.by_network: Heading above the grid of 30-day charts on the history page, one chart per network.
method.how.*: Methodology table, one plain-English sentence or two per network on how its live fee is calculated. Keep technical terms (gas, base fee, tip, rent, confirmations) consistent across rows.
method.fee_page: Link word in the methodology exchange table, e.g. 'Binance fee page'; the exchange name is added before it in code.
nav.top: Accessible label of the round green button at the bottom right that scrolls back to the top of the page.
embed.code_label: Screen-reader label of the code boxes on the embed page.
